name: Ananias (high priest)
title: High Priest who accused Paul
summary: Ananias was the high priest when Paul stood before the Council and later before the governor Felix. He ordered that Paul be struck on the mouth, and he led the accusation against him in Caesarea.

keyEvents.title: Accusing Paul
keyEvents.description: The high priest Ananias ordered that Paul be struck, and later went down to Caesarea to accuse him before Felix.
